Manifest.Name: 上层区 Upper Levels：可能是DLC
Manifest.Author: Mr.K
Manifest.Description: 把店开进上层区：8 个开局职业、48 个特性、上层区客人与派系、赛博风格店铺装修。主菜单打开「上层区模式」即可开始；只想要装修可以在设置里单独打开。Open your shop in the Upper Levels: 8 professions, 48 traits, new clients and factions, and a cyberpunk shop. Turn on Upper Levels mode in the main menu; decor-only is in Settings.
